sources.title: GitHub - jaswanthhitman45/Ai_text_detection
sources.snippet: This repository contains the full-stack academic research web application for detecting AI-generated text using a domain-adversarial contrastive language model framework. The project is designed to resolve poor cross-domain generalization, writer biases (specifically for non-native English speakers), and domain sensitivity.
